title: The Pickpocket
text: A child in a porcelain mask bumps into a Scion in the crowd, murmurs a sorry in a voice far too old, and is gone. So is their purse. A small white face looks back once from the mouth of an alley, then vanishes.

options.label: The fastest gives chase before the white face vanishes for good.

outcomes.text: Caught, and the purse back, and more besides. Under the mask the child is very old.
Lost in the crowd, and the purse with it, and two more purses gone in the chase.

options.label: Let the child keep it. Whatever wears that mask needs it more.

outcomes.text: Gone. Somewhere, a small white face is grateful.

options.label: The sharpest eye watches where it runs, to learn where such things hide.

outcomes.text: To a thieves' den, with a back door you can use.
